description: A flashcard-based learning application where users can create decks, study cards, and explore community decks.

components.name: App
components.responsibility: Main controller that manages deck creation, deck viewing, active selection, and study mode.

components.name: DeckCreator
components.responsibility: Form for creating decks and adding cards.
outputs: New Deck added to global list

components.name: FlashCard
components.responsibility: Displays a single card with a flip animation between front/back.

components.name: CardFlip
components.responsibility: Handles the animation logic for flipping cards.

components.name: Home
components.responsibility: Landing page with UI for exploring the app.

components.name: Create
components.responsibility: Page that wraps DeckCreator and handles deck creation UI.

components.name: Study
components.responsibility: Study mode for cycling through cards in a deck.

components.name: Community
components.responsibility: Shows community decks and allows selecting one to study.

components.name: Layout
components.responsibility: Page frame (header/nav layout) shared across pages.
